name: parcels_sign_law_violations
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE is_in_ravine_protection_area IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(ravine_distance_m <= 0, false)

name: permits_sign_law_violations
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE is_in_ravine_protection_area IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(ravine_distance_m <= 0, false)

name: coa_sign_law_violations
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM coa_applications WHERE is_in_ravine_protection_area IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(ravine_distance_m <= 0, false)

name: parcels_lineage_mismatch
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels p WHERE p.ravine_dataset_version_when_enriched IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT max(source_dataset_version) FROM ravines)
